selection_basis: The first four actionable records emitted by the canonical review queue after claim cleanup batch six completed and before any batch-seven rewrite was applied.

observed_initial_queue.blocked_reason: The higher-priority preview consisted of sensitive or restricted records requiring actual-source and safety review rather than automatic practical rewriting.

guardrail: This batch preserves only low-risk operational procedures. It removes inherited unsupported cognitive, statistical, first-party and performance claims, adds no source and promotes no entry to reviewed.

entries.decision: Remove unsupported working-memory and comprehension claims, fabricated internal outcomes, universal chunk counts, fixed timing and word limits and pseudo-precise audience or template multipliers. Preserve the useful structural operation: define the audience and decision, group related material, label the groups, keep the main path concise and move supporting detail into retrievable layers.

Remove unsupported rhetoric and cognitive-mechanism authority, fabricated recall and throughput effects, invented internal examples, fixed abstract-to-concrete ratios and timing prescriptions. Preserve a message-editing move: state the general point, add a concrete example or observable detail, connect the example back to the point and remove detail that does not serve the audience's task.

Remove fabricated time savings and internal experiments, arbitrary sample cutoffs, probability thresholds, fold-change rules, financial action bands and claims that a short streak is or is not random. Preserve a bounded pattern check: record the full observation window and denominator, compare the streak with its broader context, look for measurement or environment changes and avoid changing a plan solely because a short sequence looks meaningful.

Remove unsupported named-study claims, fabricated forecasting and bias effects, exercise and nutrition prescriptions, numeric source-scoring rules, fixed search durations and equal-weight both-sides framing. Preserve a critical-thinking procedure: write the specific claim, record what currently supports it, seek the strongest credible counter-information, compare source relevance and independence, then keep, narrow or revise the claim explicitly.
